versions.changelog: Add skill-card.md; fix security (remove hardcoded dynamic import)

Initial release of ebook-converter-pro – a full-featured ebook conversion and management toolbox.

- Supports converting EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 to TXT, Markdown, HTML, JSON, and images (PNG/JPG).
- Bulk/parallel conversion, progress bars, and automated conversion reports.
- Metadata reading, editing, and batch export (BibTeX/JSON supported).
- Library organization: auto-sorts by author or format, with soft links to avoid moving files.
- Extraction of ebook cover images and direct command-line manipulation of major ebook formats.
